title: The Other Widow
logline: A stranger stops Elias's burial by claiming to be his wife, but matching rings and simultaneous bank thefts turn accusation into a shared emergency.

endVote.question: Which lead should the widows follow first?

options.label: Open the coffin
options.consequence: They confront the most immediate truth but trigger the danger Theo was sent to prevent.
options.generationDirective: Open the coffin in front of the remaining mourners and make the physical evidence inside the first lead.

options.label: Trace the transfer
options.consequence: Celeste may catch the moving money while giving someone time to remove the coffin.
options.generationDirective: Let Celeste seize control of the investigation by tracing the live transfer as Mara guards the coffin.

options.label: Follow Theo
options.consequence: Mara risks losing the evidence in the chapel to learn who frightened Theo into silence.
options.generationDirective: Have Mara follow Theo into the rain and witness his covert meeting before returning to the coffin.
